revision_reason: Supplementary benchmark completed for candidates E (fb-espeak) and F (vitouphy). License review finalized. Provider selected: fb/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft.
selection_criteria: PER=30.5% (best among distributable candidates). Apache 2.0 license with clear model provenance. Native speaker training data (CommonVoice + LibriVox). Connected speech fidelity: outputs real IPA including flaps, weak forms, schwa.
research_summary: Phase 2.10 supplementary benchmark complete. Full candidate ranking: vitouphy (19.5% PER, but TIMIT license restricted — can't distribute), fb-espeak (30.5% PER, Apache 2.0 — SELECTED), MFA (33.8% PER, MIT — boundary provider only), ZIPA (50.0% PER, MIT code / model license unclear). Selection: fb-espeak as phone identity provider; MFA retained for boundary reference.

candidates.notes: Facebook official model. wav2vec2-large-lv60 fine-tuned on CommonVoice for multilingual phoneme recognition. IPA output. Trained on native speaker speech (CommonVoice + LibriVox), not L2 assessment. SELECTED as phone identity provider for Phase 2.10.
sources: https://arxiv.org/abs/XXXX (Xu, Baevski, Auli — Simple and Effective Zero-shot Cross-lingual Phoneme Recognition)

benchmark.limitations: Outputs IPA characters (not TIMIT phone set as assumed). Trained on TIMIT (LDC restricted) — cannot distribute in product. Best PER at 19.5% — serves as SOTA upper bound reference.

candidates.notes: XLS-R 300M fine-tuned directly on TIMIT (80/10/10 split). Outputs IPA characters (44 token vocab), NOT TIMIT phone set as previously assumed. SA1/SA2 PER 13.75% vs SX PER 19.44% — moderate overfitting. Best benchmark performer but blocked by TIMIT LDC restricted license.

candidates.invalidation_reason: Model designed for Korean L2 English pronunciation assessment (mispronunciation detection), NOT native English connected speech phone recognition. Low PER on TIMIT (31.5%) is coincidental: TIMIT read speech overlaps with L2 model training distribution. In real connected speech, would likely misclassify native weak forms as pronunciation errors.

benchmark.note: PER retained for reference only, not used for selection

candidates.invalidation_reason: Fine-tuned on L2-Arctic (non-native English learner speech). Same fundamental issue as slplab: L2 pronunciation assessment model, not native connected speech recognizer. PER=97% confirms output space completely mismatched with TIMIT native annotations.
